items.title: Don Albert Interview, 1969-12-30
items.q: Maybe you could find something in California or something. >> [INTERVIEWEE] Possibly so, more than likely in Texas if you could ever find someone that knew Eddie Perry.

ctx.x: So there's just a band that disappeared from the scene. That's right. Maybe you could find something in California or something.

Possibly so, more than likely in Texas if you could ever find someone that knew Eddie Perry. Did Troy Floyd have a theme? Yes, Troy's theme was, oh, let's go a little further. You have to come in. I'm afraid. I'm afraid someday you'll leave. I'm afraid someday I'll breathe. I'm afraid. It was a beautiful song. And Troy would do a spiel on it. He would talk it. Like what's this guy does is talking on his numbers. He'd sing and then he'd talk it a lot. One of the old, old timers. One of the white... I don't know.
There'd been several. Ted Lewis. There you go. You hit it right on the head. He was like, do that kind of thing?
